query: UPDATE imap_accounts a SET lease_id=$4,lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes' FROM email_links l WHERE a.link_id=$1 AND a.sync_generation=$2 AND a.grant_generation=$3 AND (a.lease_until IS NULL OR a.lease_until<now()) AND l.id=a.link_id AND l.macro_id=a.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AND l.sync_generation=a.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=a.grant_generation RETURNING a.user_id,a.credential_ciphertext,a.state,a.revision
